ranked.headline: Domain-informed molecular representations advance property and interaction prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work encodes domain structure into molecular graphs and sequences for generation, reaction prediction and drug-target interaction tasks.

ranked.headline: Generative and foundation models separate biological variation in single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent models encode explicit biological structure, such as circular cell-cycle subspaces and causal networks, directly into generative architectures.

ranked.headline: Curated references and consensus statistics refine microbial profiling tools
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications address reference database errors, limits of metagenomic functional recovery, and viral genome classification.

ranked.headline: Label-efficient segmentation across histology, electron and multiplexed microscopy
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply self-supervised, self-training and foundation-model fine-tuning to nuclei, niche, ultrastructure and cell segmentation tasks.

ranked.headline: Interpretable models predict regulatory activity and variant effects from DNA sequence
ranked.summary: Genomic deep learning work increasingly pairs predictive accuracy with explanations of regulatory and variant-level outputs.

ranked.headline: Inferring regulatory activity from splicing, fragmentation, and population-scale data
ranked.summary: Splicing-resolved, fragmentation-based, and population-scale readouts now support regulatory inference beyond direct perturbation experiments.

ranked.headline: Feedback and canalization buffer biological network outputs against perturbation
ranked.summary: Recent models of feedback, canalization, and criticality test how network architecture buffers system outputs against perturbation across scales.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer cancer subtypes and cell states from omics and histology data
ranked.summary: Preprints and papers now apply deep, contrastive and transfer learning to histology and single-cell omics data.

ranked.headline: Computational methods map spatial cell neighborhoods and pathway activity in tissues
ranked.summary: Growing spatial and single-cell tissue datasets, such as HuBMAP's healthy-tissue resource, demand standardised preprocessing and scalable analysis methods.

ranked.headline: MD simulations map dynamic allosteric routes across nucleic acid and protein assemblies
ranked.summary: Recent MD studies resolve how perturbations propagate through nucleosomes, RRMs, and receptor homodimers, moving beyond static structural description.

ranked.headline: Predictive and network-analysis software for microbiome, epigenomic, and cancer data
ranked.summary: Packaged, reproducible ML and network tools are appearing alongside domain-specific models for microbiome, histone, and cancer-progression data.

ranked.headline: Physical and geometric constraints shape biomolecular prediction and design models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply diffusion, physics-informed learning and coarse-grained models to docking, antibody design and DNA simulation.

ranked.headline: Computational tools translate sequence variation into predicted protein-level effects
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks test whether folding energy and ensemble methods reliably interpret variant effects against experimental folding and selection data.

ranked.headline: Machine learning prioritizes antimicrobial peptides and cyanine antibiotics for testing
ranked.summary: Recent studies pair deep, LLM-based models with synthesized compounds and tested peptides, linking prediction to experimental evaluation.

ranked.headline: Single-cell atlases resolve cell-type diversity across human organs and mouse development
ranked.summary: Larger integrated single-cell datasets now enable cross-donor, multi-omic, and temporal reference maps of tissue cell types.

ranked.headline: Deep learning predicts MS/MS spectra for PTMs, small molecules and DIA libraries
ranked.summary: Spectral prediction models are expanding through larger training sets, open model serving, and experiment-specific training for proteomics workflows.

ranked.headline: Coupling LLMs with biological structure and imaging features for prediction tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test LLMs on imaging, mass spectra, metabolomic, and omics data, often pairing them with explicit biological models.

ranked.headline: Inferring parameters and interactions of biological dynamical models from quantitative…
ranked.summary: Recent work couples inference machinery to specific model structures, from steady-state-constrained ODE networks to compositional Lotka-Volterra models.

ranked.headline: LLM agents and multimodal embeddings are querying public transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method pair LLM agents with transcriptomic reanalysis, cell annotation, and chat-based querying of single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Graph-based multimodal models predict protein function and drug-target interactions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method pair graph structure with language-model or sequence embeddings for biomolecular prediction.

ranked.headline: Neural models read raw sequencing, microscopy, and alignment data directly
ranked.summary: Recent preprints replace hand-engineered intermediate steps with attention and vision models trained on image series and long-read alignments.

ranked.headline: Evaluating inferred biological structure against simulated and benchmark ground truth
ranked.summary: Recent items test inferred biological relationships directly, using constraints, bootstrap difference tests, and simulated benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Tunable dosing, vector, noise, and supply inputs set population persistence outcomes
ranked.summary: Controllable inputs such as dosing schedules, vector traits, noise, and resource supply are being modeled as determinants of persistence and clearance.

ranked.headline: Preparing predicted structures for molecular dynamics and trajectory analysis
ranked.summary: Automated conversion of cofolding outputs and streaming trajectory clustering target the gap between structure prediction and simulation analysis.

ranked.headline: Software tools for genomic neighbourhoods, RNA structure, and pan-genome analysis
ranked.summary: November 2025 preprints and publications make specialized genomic and structural analyses available as web servers, R packages, and open toolkits.

ranked.headline: Local rules and crosslink disorder give rise to emergent collective dynamics
ranked.summary: Neuronal, epithelial, and condensate studies here each tie microscopic structure or local rules to emergent macroscopic behavior.

ranked.headline: Phylogeny-based and error-filtering pipelines for large eukaryotic sequence datasets
ranked.summary: Deep metabarcoding and large comparative genomics datasets now demand reference-free and error-aware processing tools.

ranked.headline: Long reads and methylation refine haplotype phasing and mitochondrial variant analysis
ranked.summary: Methylation-aware long-read tools now address haplotype and mitochondrial variation, alongside telomere and ancestry analyses at population scale.

ranked.headline: Computational models link tissue stiffness and anisotropy to organ mechanics and transport
ranked.summary: Patient-specific and reduced-order models now connect regional tissue properties to organ deformation, fluid flow, and motility outcomes.

ranked.headline: Cortical dynamics shape neuronal tuning heterogeneity and trial-to-trial variability
ranked.summary: Exact-likelihood circuit theory and parallel-pathway system identification now separate dynamical and state contributions to cortical neuronal variability.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic and neural ODE models link preclinical data, pathway kinetics and survival
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and Bayesian ODE frameworks now translate sparse preclinical, labelling and toxicity data into quantitative predictions for humans and organisms.

ranked.headline: Specificity-aware tools for microbial probe design, signature discovery and annotation
ranked.summary: Growing microbial and ribosomal sequence datasets demand tools that scale while retaining target specificity.

ranked.headline: Temporal inference of aging dynamics across clinical, ovarian, and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Large-scale temporal reconstruction now resolves age-related change from laboratory tests, intact ovaries, and single-cell embeddings.

ranked.headline: Consistent tree inference under discordance paired with pandemic-scale confidence
ranked.summary: Preprints add consistent gene, species, and network tree methods; SPRTA scales phylogenetic confidence to a two-million-genome SARS-CoV-2 tree.

ranked.headline: Long-read tools reconstruct alleles and resolve chromatin base modifications
ranked.summary: Long-read platforms generate allele-resolved and base-modification data that demand purpose-built, reproducible software for analysis.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools turn lipidomics, MS/MS, and MRS spectra into interpretable outputs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints release open software that moves lipidomics, untargeted metabolomics, and MRS data toward biological interpretation.
